message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s). Facts: Defendant bought 150 kg of bulk salt, knew it might be unqualified, used it to process tea eggs sold to others. The salt was found to be non-iodized (iodine 0), not meeting GB5416-2000 standard for refined salt grade II. In iodine-deficient area, regulations require iodized salt for food. So using non-iodized salt is illegal, violating food safety standards. The offense is likely "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" (production and sale of food not meeting safety standards). The facts involve processing tea eggs (food) with substandard salt. The crime is under food safety statutes. The correction rules: "When the facts describe the acquisition, processing, and sale of animal-derived products that are unsafe or of unknown origin, classify the offense under food safety statutes (e.g., 生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品) r". Here it's not animal-derived but still food safety. So the appropriate charge: "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". The rule about not appending “罪” after the name. So we output just the statutory offense name without the character “罪”. So answer: [罪名]生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: Possibly "非法添加非碘盐" but that's covered under food safety. No drug, no counterfeit. So single offense.
